answer: The design leans on token-curated registries for quality signals. Written in a first-principles reasoning, builds from axioms register, it stays short. The vault holds work receipts rather than names, so the ledge of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The pulse of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
